name: Auto-Manage Agent Treasury
summary: Continuously sweep idle USDC above a reserve floor into yield, and pull funds back when the agent needs to spend.
when_to_use: The agent earns and spends USDC over time and wants idle balances to always be productive without manual action. Runs as a background loop.

inputs.name: depositThreshold
inputs.description: Deposit idle USDC above this amount

inputs.name: reserveMinimum
inputs.description: Keep this much liquid for spending

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: Ongoing deposit/withdraw events as balances cross thresholds

eliza.hint: Add the plugin to your character; the ArcisTreasuryService runs this automatically.

risk: Same as the underlying vault. Reserve floor guarantees spending liquidity.
